vaultwarden.yaml
  Copyright (c) 2026 synopkgland
  License: MIT (the repository root LICENSE, ../../LICENSE)
  Independently authored SDK fixture, 2026-10-18. The previously included
  Vaultwarden wiki excerpt was replaced because its license was not established.
  No wiki prose or comments are retained. Container image names identify the
  applications used by tests; container images are not included in these files.

Scope
  This notice covers the Compose YAML/env fixtures, not container image licenses
  or the SDK planner's Go dependencies. The latter are documented separately in
  ../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt. The fixture source files are test data; they are not
  embedded in the planner executable.
